intermediate.name: 2nd passage of the finish line
intermediate.title: Sprint | 2nd passage of the finish line (87.4 km)

story: An early breakaway formed featuring mountains leader Martin Urianstad Bugge, who successfully defended his jersey despite Pepijn Reinderink topping the climbs and Jenson Plowright winning both sprints. Jay Vine attacked late, rode clear with Jhonatan Narvaez, won the stage, and took the overall lead.
